works.author: Nixtio
works.comment: 加密货币交易 App 与仪表盘：双手捧着的平板上是 LumaTrade 的 ETH/USD 走势，$3,615.86 配荧光绿 Buy BTC 按钮，右侧 ETH 12.695、USD 9,853.00 买卖面板一目了然；大标题“Your Crypto Portfolio, Fully in Your Hands”配真人手持实拍，金融产品用“真实使用场景 + 一个亮色操作按钮”讲清。
works.comment_en: Crypto trading app and dashboard: hands hold a tablet running LumaTrade's ETH/USD chart at $3,615.86, with a lime-green Buy BTC button and a buy/sell panel showing ETH 12.695 and USD 9,853.00; the headline "Your Crypto Portfolio, Fully in Your Hands" over a real hands-on photo sells a finance product with one real use scene and one bright action button.
works.title: Crypto Trading App & Dashboard

works.author: Bayu Aji Sadewa for Korsa
works.comment: 数字音频电商落地页 Brody：黑底大图只拍一只音箱的局部特写，大标题“DISCOVER / Shop / DOWNLOAD”衬线与斜体混排；下方 Aura Mini $129、Pulse One $249、Studio Max $449 三款并排标价，再用 Browse & Discover、Secure Checkout、Enjoy Better Sound 三步收尾；高价音频电商用“局部特写 + 三段价格梯度”先勾欲望、再谈购买。
works.comment_en: Brody audio e-commerce landing page: a black hero crops one speaker tight under the mixed serif-and-italic headline "DISCOVER / Shop / DOWNLOAD"; below, Aura Mini $129, Pulse One $249 and Studio Max $449 sit side by side with prices, and three steps — Browse & Discover, Secure Checkout, Enjoy Better Sound — close the page; premium audio sells desire first with a tight crop and a three-tier price ladder.
works.title: Brody - Digital Audio E-Commerce Landing Page Animation

works.author: Ronas IT | UI/UX Team
works.comment: B2B SaaS 移动端 CRM 仪表盘：三屏并排，紫色渐变看板上是“27 Nov, 09:41 AM”告警卡片“High latency detected on Auth Microservice”，中屏 1,420 次部署柱状图配 Open Incidents 14、Avg MTTR 13m，右屏任务详情“Fix Auth API Latency & Scale DB”带优先级选择；运维看板用“三屏分工：告警、指标、任务”把一次故障处理讲成完整流程。
works.comment_en: B2B SaaS mobile CRM dashboard in three phones: a purple board flags "High latency detected on Auth Microservice" at 27 Nov, 09:41 AM, the middle screen charts 1,420 deployments beside Open Incidents 14 and Avg MTTR 13m, and the right screen opens the task "Fix Auth API Latency & Scale DB" with a priority picker; one incident becomes a full workflow split across alert, metrics, and task screens.
works.title: CRM Dashboard - B2B SaaS Mobile App

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 生物实验室自动化官网 ordivalabs：蓝色大字“THE AGE OF BIOAUTOMATION IS HERE”配一只银色机械臂夹着两支试剂瓶，右侧 DATA & TRACEABILITY、PREPARE、AUTOMATE、ANALYZE 四个小标签点出流程；硬核生物技术用“一只机械臂 + 一句宣言”把自动化讲得直观有力。
works.comment_en: ordivalabs biotech lab automation site: giant blue type reads "THE AGE OF BIOAUTOMATION IS HERE" beside a silver robotic arm gripping two vials, with four small labels — DATA & TRACEABILITY, PREPARE, AUTOMATE, ANALYZE — marking the workflow; hard biotech made vivid with one robot arm and one declaration.
works.title: ordivalabs: Biotech Laboratory Automation Website UI

works.author: SM Rubel ✦
works.comment: AI 营养 App：三屏分别是“Today's Nutrition Overview”——456 kcal over 大数字配碳水 271/359g、蛋白质 202/143g、脂肪 169/359g 三项进度，中间“Today's Nutritious Meal Ideas”按早餐 945 kcal 列出水煮蛋燕麦与健康冰淇淋，右屏食谱详情 280 kcal、24 分钟、6 种食材；饮食追踪用“一个超标数字 + 一顿可执行的餐”把自律讲得不焦虑。
works.comment_en: AI nutrition app in three screens: "Today's Nutrition Overview" leads with a big "456 kcal over" beside Carbs 271/359g, Protein 202/143g and Fat 169/359g; "Today's Nutritious Meal Ideas" lists breakfast at 945 kcal — hard-boiled egg and oatmeal, healthy ice cream — and the recipe page gives 280 kcal, 24 minutes and 6 ingredients; tracking turns discipline into one honest number plus one doable meal.
works.title: AI Nutrition App UI – Smart Meal Planning & Food Tracking

works.author: Fireart UI/UX for Fireart Studio
works.comment: 供应链控制塔仪表盘 Supply Control Tower：顶部三张异常卡片先讲风险——奥克兰港关闭 4 个柜、预计延误 8–9 天、$482K 影响，下方 Projected inventory risk 曲线配 96.2% 预计满足率、14 天内缺货 23 项、18 个在途订单有风险；复杂供应链用“异常卡片先行、曲线与责任人随后”让管理者一眼抓住要处理的事。
works.comment_en: Supply Control Tower dashboard: three exception cards lead with the risk — Oakland port closure, 4 containers, an 8–9 day delay worth $482K — above a projected inventory risk curve, a 96.2% projected fill rate, 23 stockouts within 14 days and 18 inbound POs at risk, with named owners below; a tangled supply chain reads at a glance because exceptions come first and curves and owners follow.
works.title: Supply Chain Dashboard

works.author: Nebs Creative
works.comment: 智能家居能源 App Nebs：米色底上一部手机，大标题“Embrace a lifestyle of intelligent organization and efficiency”，Music 460.5 kWh、Toaster 325.6 kWh、Turntable 256.5 kWh 三张设备卡用橙色渐变配开关；每台设备的耗电量直接写在卡片上，节能建议不再是抽象数字、而是每件家电的账单。
works.comment_en: Nebs smart home energy app: one phone on a peach background under "Embrace a lifestyle of intelligent organization and efficiency", with device cards for Music (460.5 kWh), Toaster (325.6 kWh) and Turntable (256.5 kWh) in orange gradients with toggles; putting each appliance's consumption on its card turns saving energy from an abstract number into a bill per device.
works.title: Smart Home Energy App AI-Powered Device Control UI UX | Nebs

works.author: Mehedi Hasan ✪
works.comment: 智能学习 App：紫黄撞色的三屏，左屏卡通男孩戴着毕业帽骑铅笔、“Welcome to Smart Learning”，中屏“Ready to learn today?”配 Olympiad Mastery Hub、12 节课、43 学习小时，右屏 Learning plan 上 40 节课、12 个课程、78% 平均进度；儿童教育 App 用“卡通主角 + 大色块进度”把学习讲得像游戏闯关。
works.comment_en: Smart Learning e-learning app in three purple-and-yellow screens: a cartoon boy in a graduation cap rides a pencil under "Welcome to Smart Learning", "Ready to learn today?" opens the Olympiad Mastery Hub with 12 lessons and 43 study hours, and the Learning plan shows 40 classes, 12 lessons and 78% average progress; a kids' learning app borrows game language — cartoon hero plus big color-blocked progress — to make studying feel like leveling up.
works.title: E-Learning Mobile App UI Design — Smart Learning App
